children: The Bank of Canada maintained the target for its overnight rate unchanged at 2.25% in its September 2026 decision, as expected by markets, but flagged stronger upside risks to inflation.

The Governing Council noted that the Canadian economy underwent a broad recovery in the second quarter, underscoring some resilience to adverse economic conditions since the outbreak of war in the Middle East lifted energy prices and long-maturity yields domestically.
On top of that, flagged upside inflation risks from the continuation of the war and the reintroduction of aggressive tariffs on Canadian exports to the United States.
Still, the BoC noted that underlying inflation has so far maintained its target level despite the shock in energy prices since March.
Despite stressing higher inflation risks, the bank reiterated that the uncertain outlook prevents any clear signals on monetary policy this year.

title: Bank of Canada Holds Rate at 2.25%
